decision.explanation: Document d3 explicitly links the director of Avatar (2009) to the director of Titanic (1997), while document d1 identifies James Cameron as the director associated with Gale Anne Hurd, a producer of his films; document d2 contains a contradictory claim about Christoph Gans that is invalidated by the specific filmography details in d3 and the established link between Cameron and Hurd.
